messages:
Asha (CS): Heads-up — VerdantLogic is asking to add two new squads (Search + Ingest) and move realtime summarization into prod. They expect ~3x QPS next quarter and asked about data residency/SOC2.
Miguel (AE): Do they want Dedicated, Private, or try hosted with burst first?
Asha (CS): They said SOC2 + VPC is preferred. Also asked about burst for seasonal load.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Private + realtime -> we'll need KV caching tuned and likely a quantized model for cost. I can draft a sizing suggestion.
Priya (Customer): Confirming — we need low latency for customer-facing features. Token-level cost breakdown during pilot would help our finance review.
Devon (Eng): For steady 3x QPS estimate, plan is 2 dedicated pods with autoscale up to 4 for burst. If they want p50 <100ms we'll need us-west edge routing + smaller context windows.
Asha (CS): Action list: 1) Jordan to propose deployment config + delta cost 2) Miguel to update renewal/upsell play 3) Book enablement / runbook for their PM/Dev.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): I'll open a config snippet PR by EOD. Example config:
```
model: redwood/70B-quant
deployment: private-vpc
dedicated_pods: 2
autoscale_max: 4
cache_policy: prefix_kv
monitoring: token_cost, latency_p50_p95
```
Miguel (AE): Noted — I'll draft a Dedicated pilot quote. If spend crosses our dollar threshold we can flip to Org SLA.
Asha (CS): On renewal risk: their renewal is in ~30 days. If we don't show a cost + perf plan, risk increases. Marking as high-priority.
onboard-bot: Reminder: VerdantLogic renewal date 2025-11-12 (30 days). Ticket #2345 created for SOC2 docs intake.
Priya (Customer): Can we do a 1-hour enablement session next Thu morning PST? Prefer an engineer + SE.
Asha (CS): Scheduled — Jordan + Devon will join. Miguel will send cost options and pilot timeline.
Devon (Eng): FYI — if they want end-to-end reproducible latency we should enable canary routing: hosted fallback -> dedicated -> private. I can add a routing policy example.
Asha (CS): I've flagged this as expansion-opportunity in CRM and added to weekly CSM sync. Will update after Jordan's PR.
Miguel (AE): :thumbsup: I'll prep upsell materials and a renewal outreach plan.
Priya (Customer): Appreciate it, thanks everyone!
